pattern: に至っても（にいたっても）
purpose: Emphasize that something remains unchanged even at a late stage.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
V dictionary / N + に至っても
Even when it reached court, he did not apologize.
Even when the company went bankrupt, management denied responsibility.
Even on the day of the deadline, there is no reply.
formation: V dictionary / N + に至っても
restrictions: Usually followed by a negative or unchanged response.
mistake: The point is persistence despite escalation, not simply reaching a stage.
